# Real config files for round-trip tests

- `starship-catppuccin-powerline.toml`: output of `starship preset catppuccin-powerline` from starship 1.27.0 (ISC licence).
- `lazygit-default.yml`: output of `lazygit --config` from lazygit 0.66.2, the default configuration (MIT licence).

Both were generated on 2026-11-06. Regenerate them with the same commands to test against newer releases.
